headline: Styrofoam collection on January 9, 2027 and a ToughStuff Recycling tour are planned, along with city updates and 2027 goals.
summary: The agenda includes city updates from the Chief of Staff and Sustainability and from the Solid Waste Recycling officer. It also lists a Styrofoam collection on January 9, 2027 and a ToughStuff Recycling tour with a date to be determined.
